audit.why: Both layers agree the lane is even until 3, Pantheon owns the level-3 burst window, and 4-5 flips toward Zaahen's ramp. That matches the kits: Pantheon has his full combo at 3 while Cultivation of War stacks need repeated champion contact to matter.

audit.why: Zaahen's real spikes are Aureate Rush online (10s dash), Grim Deliverance at 6 (110s, heals), and full Determination (bonus AD plus a revive).
audit.corrected: Did not add a fourth spike — inserting an entry changes the entry count, which the brief forbids. Flagged for the user. Prose spikes for 4-5 and late now carry the real ability names and cooldowns via whys[3] and whys[6].

audit.whatIsWrong: The whole matchup tracked a generic 'Zaahen's Ultimate' and never named a single Zaahen ability. The decisive interaction — Aegis Assault is a channel and his displacements break it — was absent.
audit.why: Aegis Assault (E, 22/21/20/19/18) is flagged channel: interruptible. Zaahen's The Darkin Glaive (Q, 10/9/8/7/6) can be recast so his next attack knocks up, and Dreaded Return (W, 14/13.5/13/12.5/12, 850 range) stabs then pulls. Either displacement lands on you while you are shielded. Aureate Rush (E, 10/9.5/9/8.5/8) is his gap-closer and deals percent health, so stacking armour is not the answer.
audit.corrected: report[5].t, dontsFull[0].d and breakdown.cooldowns now name Q/W/E/R and state that his knockup and pull break your channel, so Aegis Assault goes up after his displacement rather than before it.
